def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    comps=components(I)
    order=sorted(comps,key=lambda o:(min(p[0] for p in o), -max(p[1] for p in o)))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    placed=set()
    for comp in order:
        cells=[(r,c) for r,c in comp]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]; left,right=min(cs),max(cs)
        step=0
        while right+step+1 < W and any((r,left+step+1) in placed or (r,right+step+1) in placed for r,cl_ in [(x,y) for x,y in cells]): pass
        # clean version: slide right step by step; allowed if all shifted cells free
        s=0
        while True:
            cand={(r,c+s+1) for r,c in cells}
            if not any(t in placed for t in cand):
                s+=1
            else: break
        for r,c in cells:
            newc=c+s
            assert 0<=newc<W
            out[r][newc]=I[r][c]; placed.add((r,newc))
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]);res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    occ={}
    # cells not moved yet? treat occupied as anything non-zero in input; all shift right
    cs=[(v,tuple(sorted(cells))) for v,cells in comps(g)]
    order=sorted(cs,key=lambda kv:kv[1][-1][1],reverse=True)  # max col desc
    for val,cells in order:
        wdt=max(p[1] for p in cells)-min(p[1] for p in cells)+1
        best=None
        for s in range(min(W-wdt, max(p[1] for p in cells)), -1, -1):
            nxt=tuple((r,c+s) for r,c in cells)
            if all((rr,cc) not in occ for rr,cc in nxt):
                best=s;break
        if best is None: continue
        for r,c in cells: res[r][c+best]=val
        for r,c in cells: occ[(r,c+best)]=val
    return res
